properties: Atomic publication and session identity; old reports cannot overwrite newer state; terminal settings require current terminal/lease witnesses, one-time import and convergent master revisions; prompt answers require complete valid transcript fields and the same literal question/options (including paired globs and rendered code) or complete review and screen; failed transcript checks retain no answer keys; pre-session trust input requires a current pane/terminal/process witness with no session, complete workspace heading/folder and question, exact menu identity ignoring only the option cursor before every key, and the per-pane input lock; Needs you displays trust safety text and grant warnings unclamped
assessment: direct report/session parsing/publication, Python-free remote Codex lookup, Claude host-local UUID read/send fixtures, and one-shot preview/confirmation fixtures; runtime admission delegated to qualified-operation
remaining: The external runtime cannot atomically compare the foreground process and report a link; preview/confirmation tests do not claim to close that final RPC race. Session identity is a distinct consumer guard; parsing all external formats is direct fixture evidence, not a manager guarantee.

evidenceDecision: Headless conversation discovery adds bounded writable-descriptor/process-start evidence, real Linux/macOS writer consumers, macOS field fixtures and SSH destination/failure fixtures; see the Q25 headless identity assessment in consumer-evidence.md. Captured runtime authority applies to checkout report reads. Real history/task parsers and checkout tests check transcript order and exact live session identity. Direct Codex protocol and inference fixtures check bounded complete discovery, title precedence, contradictory reports, two-sided uniqueness, freshness, changing evidence, connection isolation and refusal of guessed message/answer input; inferred evidence never establishes client identity. Claude SSH fixtures execute the production POSIX lookup/stat/read payloads against a disposable filesystem with a synthetic Herdr source, checking remote read/send/receipt, duplicate and malformed IDs, missing files, stale-session refusal and connection isolation; native SSH/Claude acceptance is not claimed. Repository popover consumers also verify that retained PR/MR reports stay within the complete connection/runtime/workspace/checkout/cwd/branch/worktree association: a failed read after target replacement cannot reuse the former request, while same-association refresh failures retain it. This is direct React consumer evidence for a read-only report cache, not an abstract model of provider or Git semantics. Per-terminal settings add direct P5 platform checks and P7 finite exhaustive convergence evidence; the unchanged runtime-leases model supplies only lease authority, not token atomicity or HLC convergence. See the terminal-settings contract for the finite domain, migration and platform limits. The send-guard consumer drives the real Herdr conversation source with a captured menu on screen: a message or command is refused with nothing typed while the menu is open and sent once it closes, and a command queued while the agent is working is not queued twice. The send-boundary consumer (real conversation source, fake Herdr) refuses typing when the pre-prompt screen read fails, is malformed, shows a cut-off or any menu under a stale working status, or when a menu opens during preparation awaits, and keeps ordinary text and distinct commands allowed; identical slash commands are reserved before dispatch, kept after a lost acknowledgement but released after definite native non-submission, retired only by qualified fresh session/idle observations (never malformed, unknown or pre-dispatch reads), scoped to the session and busy interval, and not cancelled by dismissing a receipt. The send-repair consumer also checks local and SSH quoted-footer compatibility, including browser baselines: quote text is read from the same bound session and recognizes the Claude message prefix. Partial boxed options and blank-padded menu evidence refuse despite lacking answer controls, while a changed terminal/state witness in the final native observation refuses before dispatch; actual menus, failed/malformed screens and replacement sessions still refuse. The waiting-render consumer (pendingSends, static render) shows waiting only for a receipt the service marks waiting and otherwise the unchecked label; it does not claim native execution. No real harness send is exercised: Herdr refuses prompts to synthetic panes, so queue admission end to end remains unexercised. Candidate Ranger/transcript integration adds concrete Claude driver/MCP, continuation/append and qualified navigation/task-membership consumers. Existing model bounds, mandatory native/platform consumers and excluded claims remain unchanged; independent candidate acceptance is required. Continuation regressions require bounded top-level provenance, renewed remote UUID/path authority and owned local process cancellation; nested or discarded branch content cannot establish a session. Local configured-root parity is not claimed.
